# Overview

1. Cleans and harmonises case (Marfan) and control data
2. Performs propensity-score matching (1:4, exact on 5-year birth cohort)
3. Assesses covariate balance after matching
4. Primary analysis: conditional logistic regression for POP in cases vs. matched controls
5. Sensitivity and robustness analyses: Fisher's exact test, adjustment for age at
   first birth, 1:10 matching, full-cohort adjusted logistic regression, and
   variability across equally valid matched samples
6. Exploratory: time to POP, parity as an effect modifier

```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("MatchIt", "dplyr", "tableone", "lubridate",

```

```{r load-packages}
library(MatchIt)
library(dplyr)
library(tableone)
library(lubridate)
library(survival)

library(tidyverse)
```

## Reading in the data

The data files must be located in the current working directory and named
exactly as below. Double-check file paths/names if this step fails.

2,491 lines in the control file contain an extra, unlabelled field (a date or
blank) between `BMI` and `ever_smoked`. Read as-is, this shifts smoking and
menopause values for those rows. The function below removes the extra field
before the file is read, and checks every line then has 11 fields.

```{r read-data}
read_ukb_fixed <- function(path) {
  raw <- readLines(path)
  n_fields <- count.fields(path, sep = ",", quote = "\"",
                           comment.char = "", blank.lines.skip = FALSE)
  stopifnot(length(n_fields) == length(raw))

  bad <- n_fields == 12
  cat(path, "- lines with an extra field removed:", sum(bad), "\n")

  # Drop the 10th field (unlabelled date between BMI and ever_smoked)
  raw[bad] <- sub("^((?:[^,]*,){9})[^,]*,", "\\1", raw[bad], perl = TRUE)

  # Every line should now have 11 fields
  check <- count.fields(textConnection(raw), sep = ",", quote = "\"",
                        comment.char = "", blank.lines.skip = FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(check == 11))

  read.csv(text = raw, na.strings = c("", " "))
}

mfn1 <- read_ukb_fixed("mfn1.2.csv")
mfn2 <- read_ukb_fixed("mfn2.2.csv")

# Field 3872 not in extract: age at first birth unavailable for women with one live birth
if (!"age_primiparous" %in% names(mfn1)) mfn1$age_primiparous <- NA
if (!"age_primiparous" %in% names(mfn2)) mfn2$age_primiparous <- NA
```

# Data Cleaning

The raw data require cleaning because of:

- A high prevalence of missing values (`NA`)
- The need for consistent variable types across cases and controls for matching

**Notes on specific variables:**

- `DOB` (year of birth) is binned into 5-year intervals for exact matching. This
  allows better control availability than exact-year matching.
- UK Biobank negative codes (-3 prefer not to answer, -4 do not remember) are set
  to missing for parity and age at first birth.
- Smoking and menopausal status are coded as factors, with missing or non-standard
  responses kept as their own level ("Unknown", "Unsure/unknown") rather than
  dropped. "Not sure - had a hysterectomy" is kept as a separate menopause level.
- Age at first birth is available only for women with two or more live births
  (field 2754); field 3872 (women with one live birth) was not in the extract.

> **Before running:** check `range(ukb_data$DOB, na.rm = TRUE)` and adjust the
> `seq()` bounds in `DOB_bin` below if birth years fall outside 1930-1975.

```{r clean-function}
clean_df <- function(df, ctd_value, cohort_value) {

  if (!"age_primiparous" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Column 'age_primiparous' not found - check the read-in chunk.")
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      CTD            = ctd_value,
      cohort         = cohort_value,
      POP            = as.integer(!is.na(POP_diagnosis)),
      POP_diagnosis  = as.Date(POP_diagnosis),
      DOB            = as.numeric(DOB),
      BMI            = as.numeric(BMI),
      townsend_deprivation = as.numeric(townsend_deprivation),
      eid            = as.numeric(eid),
      CTD            = as.numeric(CTD),

      # UKB negative codes (-3 prefer not to answer, -4 do not remember) -> NA
      X._live_birth      = ifelse(as.numeric(X._live_birth) < 0, NA,
                                  as.numeric(X._live_birth)),
      age_at_first_birth = ifelse(as.numeric(age_at_first_birth) < 0, NA,
                                  as.numeric(age_at_first_birth)),   # field 2754
      age_primiparous    = ifelse(as.numeric(age_primiparous) < 0, NA,
                                  as.numeric(age_primiparous)),      # field 3872 (empty)

      # Combined age at first birth
      age_first_birth_all = case_when(
        X._live_birth == 0 ~ NA_real_,
        X._live_birth == 1 ~ age_primiparous,
        X._live_birth >= 2 ~ age_at_first_birth
      ),

      # Banded version for the balance table
      afb_band = factor(
        case_when(
          X._live_birth == 0          ~ "No births",
          X._live_birth == 1          ~ "One birth (age n/a)",
          is.na(age_first_birth_all)  ~ "Unknown",
          age_first_birth_all < 20    ~ "<20",
          age_first_birth_all < 25    ~ "20-24",
          age_first_birth_all < 30    ~ "25-29",
          TRUE                        ~ "30+"
        ),
        levels = c("No births", "One birth (age n/a)",
                   "<20", "20-24", "25-29", "30+", "Unknown")
      ),

      # Binary version for the sensitivity model: first birth before 25
      early_first_birth = factor(
        case_when(
          X._live_birth == 0          ~ "No",
          X._live_birth == 1          ~ "One birth (age n/a)",
          is.na(age_first_birth_all)  ~ "Unknown",
          age_first_birth_all < 25    ~ "Yes",
          TRUE                        ~ "No"
        ),
        levels = c("No", "Yes", "One birth (age n/a)", "Unknown")
      ),

      ever_smoked = factor(
        case_when(
          as.character(ever_smoked) == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
          as.character(ever_smoked) == "No"  ~ "No",
          TRUE                               ~ "Unknown"
        ),
        levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
      ),

      had_menopause = factor(
        case_when(
          as.character(had_menopause) == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
          as.character(had_menopause) == "No"  ~ "No",
          grepl("hysterectomy", as.character(had_menopause),
                ignore.case = TRUE)            ~ "Hysterectomy",
          TRUE                                 ~ "Unsure/unknown"
        ),
        levels = c("No", "Yes", "Hysterectomy", "Unsure/unknown")
      ),

      DOB_bin = cut(
        as.numeric(DOB),
        breaks = seq(1930, 1975, by = 5),
        right  = FALSE,
        labels = c("1930-34", "1935-39", "1940-44", "1945-49",
                   "1950-54", "1955-59", "1960-64", "1965-69",
                   "1970-74")
      ),
      DOB_month = as.factor(DOB_month),
      cohort    = as.factor(cohort)
    )
}
```

```{r apply-cleaning}
# Raw values before cleaning (cases)
table(mfn1$ever_smoked, useNA = "always")
table(mfn1$had_menopause, useNA = "always")

cases    <- clean_df(mfn1, ctd_value = 1, cohort_value = "cases")
controls <- clean_df(mfn2, ctd_value = 0, cohort_value = "controls")
ukb_data <- bind_rows(cases, controls)
```

## Coercion checks

Warnings are switched off in this document, so values that fail to convert to
numbers are counted explicitly here instead.

```{r coercion-checks}
check_coercion <- function(x) {
  bad <- x[!is.na(x) & is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))]
  list(n_bad = length(bad), examples = head(unique(bad), 10))
}

check_coercion(mfn1$eid)
check_coercion(mfn2$eid)
check_coercion(mfn2$X._live_birth)
check_coercion(mfn2$age_at_first_birth)
check_coercion(mfn2$BMI)
check_coercion(mfn2$townsend_deprivation)

cat("Rows with missing eid after cleaning:", sum(is.na(ukb_data$eid)), "\n")
```

## Sanity checks on date-of-birth binning

```{r dob-check}
cat("DOB range:", range(ukb_data$DOB, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Cases with NA DOB_bin:", sum(is.na(ukb_data$DOB_bin[ukb_data$cohort == "cases"])), "\n")
```

## Filtering complete cases

All Marfan cases are retained regardless of missingness, while controls are
restricted to those with complete data on the covariates used for matching.
(Smoking and menopausal status cannot be `NA` after recoding, as missing
responses form their own level.)

```{r filter-complete}
ukb_clean <- ukb_data %>%
  filter(
    cohort == "cases" |
      (cohort == "controls" &
         !is.na(townsend_deprivation) &
         !is.na(DOB) &
         !is.na(DOB_bin) &
         !is.na(BMI) &
         !is.na(X._live_birth) &
         !is.na(ever_smoked) &
         !is.na(had_menopause))
  )

stopifnot(sum(ukb_clean$cohort == "cases") == 37)
```

```{r filter-sanity-checks}
table(ukb_clean$cohort)
table(ukb_clean$cohort, ukb_clean$POP)   # POP counts in the full cohort
table(ukb_clean$DOB_bin, ukb_clean$cohort)

# Recoded variables: nothing lost or collapsed?
table(ukb_clean$ever_smoked, ukb_clean$cohort, useNA = "always")
table(ukb_clean$had_menopause, ukb_clean$cohort, useNA = "always")
table(ukb_clean$afb_band, ukb_clean$cohort, useNA = "always")
table(ukb_clean$early_first_birth, ukb_clean$cohort, useNA = "always")
```

# Propensity Score Matching

Each case is matched to four controls without replacement by nearest-neighbour
matching on a logistic regression propensity score estimated from Townsend
deprivation, birth cohort, BMI, smoking status, menopausal status, and number
of live births. Matching is exact on 5-year birth cohort (`DOB_bin`) and
restricted to a caliper of 0.2 standard deviations of the propensity score.
Ethnicity is not included as a matching variable because all Marfan cases are
recorded as White British.

```{r prep-matching}
ukb_clean$marfan <- ifelse(ukb_clean$cohort == "cases", 1, 0)

ps_formula <- marfan ~
  townsend_deprivation +
  DOB_bin +
  BMI +
  ever_smoked +
  had_menopause +
  X._live_birth
```

```{r match}
match_out <- matchit(
  formula     = ps_formula,
  data        = ukb_clean,
  method      = "nearest",
  ratio       = 4,
  distance    = "glm",
  caliper     = 0.2,
  std.caliper = TRUE,
  exact       = ~ DOB_bin,
  verbose     = FALSE
)

summary(match_out)

matched_data <- match.data(match_out) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("controls", "cases")))  # controls = reference

# Stop if any case failed to match
n_matched_cases <- sum(matched_data$marfan == 1)
if (n_matched_cases < 37) {
  stop(paste("Only", n_matched_cases, "of 37 cases matched - check the propensity model."))
}
```

## Post-matching sanity checks

```{r matched-sanity-checks}
table(matched_data$cohort)
table(table(matched_data$subclass))   # matched-set sizes (5 = 1 case + 4 controls)
table(matched_data$had_menopause, matched_data$cohort)
```

# Balance Diagnostics

Standardised mean differences (SMD) below 0.1 indicate good balance between
cases and controls. Age at first birth (`afb_band`) was not a matching variable
and is shown for information.

```{r balance-table}
vars_to_check <- c("DOB", "DOB_bin", "BMI", "townsend_deprivation",
                   "ever_smoked", "had_menopause",
                   "X._live_birth", "afb_band")

tab_matched <- CreateTableOne(
  vars   = vars_to_check,
  strata = "cohort",
  data   = matched_data,
  test   = FALSE
)

print(tab_matched, smd = TRUE)
```

# Primary Analysis: Conditional Logistic Regression

All odds ratios compare Marfan cases with controls (controls = reference).

```{r pop-counts}
pop_tab <- table(matched_data$cohort, matched_data$POP)
pop_tab
round(prop.table(pop_tab, 1) * 100, 1)
```

```{r clr-primary}
clr_model <- clogit(POP ~ cohort + strata(subclass),
                    data = matched_data, method = "exact")
round(exp(cbind(OR = coef(clr_model), confint(clr_model))), 2)
summary(clr_model)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
```

# Sensitivity and Robustness Analyses

## Fisher's exact test

Ignores the matched sets; included as a check given the small number of events.

```{r fisher-test}
fisher_result <- fisher.test(pop_tab)
round(c(OR    = unname(fisher_result$estimate),
        lower = fisher_result$conf.int[1],
        upper = fisher_result$conf.int[2],
        p     = fisher_result$p.value), 3)
```

## Adjustment for first birth before age 25

Age at first birth was not matched on. This model additionally adjusts for first
birth before 25 (available only for women with two or more live births).

```{r clr-afb}
matched_data$early_first_birth <- droplevels(matched_data$early_first_birth)

clr_afb <- clogit(POP ~ cohort + early_first_birth + strata(subclass),
                  data = matched_data, method = "exact")
round(exp(cbind(OR = coef(clr_afb), confint(clr_afb))), 2)
summary(clr_afb)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
```

## 1:10 matching

```{r match-1to10}
match_out_10 <- matchit(
  formula     = ps_formula,
  data        = ukb_clean,
  method      = "nearest",
  ratio       = 10,
  distance    = "glm",
  caliper     = 0.2,
  std.caliper = TRUE,
  exact       = ~ DOB_bin,
  verbose     = FALSE
)

matched_10 <- match.data(match_out_10) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("controls", "cases")))

table(matched_10$cohort)
table(matched_10$cohort, matched_10$POP)

clr_10 <- clogit(POP ~ cohort + strata(subclass),
                 data = matched_10, method = "exact")
round(exp(cbind(OR = coef(clr_10), confint(clr_10))), 2)
summary(clr_10)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
```

## Full cohort, no matching

Logistic regression across all eligible women, adjusted for the matching covariates.

```{r full-cohort}
full_fit <- glm(POP ~ marfan + DOB_bin + BMI + townsend_deprivation +
                  ever_smoked + had_menopause + X._live_birth,
                data = ukb_clean, family = binomial)

round(exp(cbind(OR = coef(full_fit), confint.default(full_fit)))["marfan", ], 2)
summary(full_fit)$coefficients["marfan", "Pr(>|z|)"]

# All 37 cases used? (glm silently drops rows with missing covariates)
sum(full_fit$model$marfan)
nrow(full_fit$model)
```

## Variability across equally valid matches

The 1:4 match draws 148 controls from over 216,000. For each case, every control
in the same birth cohort and within the caliper is an equally acceptable match.
This section counts those candidates, then repeatedly draws 4 of them at random
per case to show how much the OR varies across valid matched samples.

```{r random-within-caliper}
set.seed(2026)

ps_fit <- glm(ps_formula, data = ukb_clean, family = binomial)
ps     <- ps_fit$fitted.values
cal    <- 0.2 * sd(ps)

case_idx <- which(ukb_clean$marfan == 1)
ctrl_idx <- which(ukb_clean$marfan == 0)

# Candidate controls for each case: same birth cohort, within the caliper
pools <- lapply(case_idx, function(i) {
  ctrl_idx[ukb_clean$DOB_bin[ctrl_idx] == ukb_clean$DOB_bin[i] &
           abs(ps[ctrl_idx] - ps[i]) <= cal]
})

# How many equally valid controls each case has, and what share of them have POP
pool_size <- sapply(pools, length)
pool_pop  <- sapply(pools, function(p) mean(ukb_clean$POP[p]))
summary(pool_size)
round(summary(pool_pop), 3)

# Expected number of matched controls with POP in any valid 1:4 match
exp_pop <- sum(4 * pool_pop)
sd_pop  <- sqrt(sum(4 * pool_pop * (1 - pool_pop)))
round(c(expected = exp_pop,
        low  = exp_pop - 2 * sd_pop,
        high = exp_pop + 2 * sd_pop), 1)

# 500 random valid matched samples
rand_df <- bind_rows(lapply(1:500, function(r) {
  sets <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(case_idx), function(k) {
    p <- pools[[k]]
    data.frame(row = c(case_idx[k], p[sample.int(length(p), min(4, length(p)))]),
               subclass = k)
  }))
  d <- ukb_clean[sets$row, ]
  d$subclass <- sets$subclass
  d$cohort <- factor(d$cohort, levels = c("controls", "cases"))
  fit <- clogit(POP ~ cohort + strata(subclass), data = d, method = "exact")
  data.frame(or       = unname(exp(coef(fit))),
             p        = unname(summary(fit)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
             ctrl_pop = sum(d$POP[d$cohort == "controls"]))
}))

round(quantile(rand_df$or, c(0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975)), 2)
mean(rand_df$or > 1)
mean(rand_df$p < 0.05)
summary(rand_df$ctrl_pop)

hist(rand_df$or, breaks = 30, main = "OR across 500 equally valid matched samples",
     xlab = "Odds ratio (Marfan vs controls)")
abline(v = 1, lty = 2)
```

# Exploratory: Time to POP Diagnosis

Age is calculated from year and month of birth (day set to the 15th, as full
date of birth is not released). Follow-up starts on 1 April 1997, when linked
hospital records begin in England, and ends on 30 November 2022. Each woman
enters the analysis at her age on the start date (late entry). Women whose POP
was recorded before the start date are excluded from this analysis, as their
time at risk cannot be observed.

```{r survival-prep}
follow_up_start <- as.Date("1997-04-01")
censor_date     <- as.Date("2022-11-30")

matched_data <- matched_data %>%
  mutate(
    dob_month_num = match(as.character(DOB_month), month.name),
    dob_month_num = ifelse(is.na(dob_month_num), 7, dob_month_num),
    dob_date      = as.Date(paste(DOB, dob_month_num, 15, sep = "-")),
    age_at_POP    = ifelse(POP == 1,
                           as.numeric(POP_diagnosis - dob_date) / 365.25, NA),
    entry_age     = as.numeric(follow_up_start - dob_date) / 365.25,
    exit_age      = ifelse(POP == 1, age_at_POP,
                           as.numeric(censor_date - dob_date) / 365.25),
    event         = as.integer(POP == 1),
    prevalent     = POP == 1 & POP_diagnosis <= follow_up_start
  )

# Year of POP diagnosis by group, and how many fall before follow-up starts
table(format(matched_data$POP_diagnosis, "%Y"), matched_data$cohort)
table(prevalent = matched_data$prevalent, matched_data$cohort)

surv_data <- matched_data %>% filter(!prevalent)
table(surv_data$cohort, surv_data$event)
```

```{r pop-age-check}
pop_dates <- ukb_clean %>%
  filter(POP == 1) %>%
  mutate(year_of_POP = as.numeric(format(POP_diagnosis, "%Y")),
         age_at_POP  = year_of_POP - DOB)

# How many POP records have no usable date, or an implausible one?
pop_dates %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(n            = n(),
            no_date      = sum(is.na(POP_diagnosis)),
            before_birth = sum(year_of_POP < DOB, na.rm = TRUE),
            after_2022   = sum(year_of_POP > 2022, na.rm = TRUE))

# What the undated records look like in the raw file
undated <- pop_dates$eid[is.na(pop_dates$POP_diagnosis)]
head(unique(mfn2$POP_diagnosis[mfn2$eid %in% undated]), 20)

# Age at POP diagnosis, plausible dates only (descriptive)
pop_dates %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_at_POP), year_of_POP >= DOB, year_of_POP <= 2022) %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(n             = n(),
            median        = median(age_at_POP),
            q1            = quantile(age_at_POP, 0.25),
            q3            = quantile(age_at_POP, 0.75),
            before_50     = sum(age_at_POP < 50),
            pct_before_50 = round(mean(age_at_POP < 50) * 100, 1))

# What are the post-2022 dates?
table(format(pop_dates$POP_diagnosis[pop_dates$year_of_POP > 2022], "%Y"))
max(pop_dates$POP_diagnosis, na.rm = TRUE)

# Age at POP within the matched sample (same birth cohorts)
matched_data %>%
  filter(POP == 1) %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(n         = n(),
            median    = round(median(age_at_POP), 1),
            q1        = round(quantile(age_at_POP, 0.25), 1),
            q3        = round(quantile(age_at_POP, 0.75), 1),
            before_50 = sum(age_at_POP < 50))
```

## Kaplan-Meier curves

```{r km-curves, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(entry_age, exit_age, event) ~ cohort, data = surv_data)

ggsurvplot(km_fit,
           data        = surv_data,
           conf.int    = TRUE,
           censor      = FALSE,
           xlim        = c(40, 85),
           xlab        = "Age (years)",
           ylab        = "Proportion free of POP",
           title       = "Time to POP diagnosis: Marfan vs matched controls",
           legend.labs = c("Controls", "Marfan"),
           palette     = c("#E87070", "#70B8E8"))
```

## Cox proportional hazards model

Stratified by matched set, with late entry at the start of follow-up.

```{r cox-model}
cox_model <- coxph(Surv(entry_age, exit_age, event) ~ cohort + strata(subclass),
                   data = surv_data)
round(exp(cbind(HR = coef(cox_model), confint(cox_model))), 2)
summary(cox_model)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]

cox.zph(cox_model)   # proportional hazards check
```

# Exploratory: Parity as an Effect Modifier

With few POP events among cases, this interaction is exploratory only. In this
model, `cohortcases` is the Marfan OR at zero live births, and the interaction
term is the change in that OR per additional birth.

```{r clr-parity}
clr_parity <- clogit(POP ~ cohort * X._live_birth + strata(subclass),
                     data   = matched_data,
                     method = "exact")
summary(clr_parity)
```

The menopause interaction model is not run: with four menopause levels and few
events, it cannot be estimated reliably.

# Supplementary Plots

## Covariate balance plot

```{r balance-plot}
plot(summary(match_out), abs = TRUE)
```

Balance for each matching variable is shown in the balance table above; SMDs
above 0.1 indicate residual imbalance after matching. Age at first birth was not
a matching variable and is addressed in the sensitivity analysis above.

## POP rate by cohort

```{r pop-rate-bar}
matched_data %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(pop_rate = mean(POP) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cohort, y = pop_rate, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "POP Rate by Cohort",
       x = "", y = "POP Rate (%)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Age at POP diagnosis

```{r age-at-pop-hist}
matched_data %>%
  filter(POP == 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age_at_POP, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, bins = 10, position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Age at POP Diagnosis",
       x = "Age (years)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Parity by POP status and cohort

*Exploratory only.*

```{r parity-pop-bar}
matched_data %>%
  mutate(POP = factor(POP, labels = c("No POP", "POP"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(X._live_birth), fill = POP)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort) +
  labs(title = "Parity by POP Status and Cohort",
       x = "Number of Live Births", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```
